description: This file defines a Spring Data repository interface named TransactionRepository for managing Transaction entities. It extends CrudRepository, providing basic CRUD operations, and declares a custom method findByAccountNumber to retrieve transactions by account number.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Transaction entities, providing CRUD operations and custom query method.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions associated with a specific account number, wrapped in an Optional.
